name: ConnectWise Automate
summary: ConnectWise Automate is sold to managed service providers and publishes no prices, only Request Pricing links. Its patch page promises deployment windows by day, time, site or device, third-party application patching, and a compliance dashboard. A trial is available on request.

facts.text: ConnectWise Automate's page says patch deployment windows can be set by day, time, site or device, and missed updates are retried.
The page names Adobe Acrobat Reader, Dropbox, Slack and Zoom as examples of third-party applications it patches.
The dashboard tracks patch compliance status, device patch history and patching schedules, and the FAQ mentions per-device OS patch compliance scores.

plans.name: Quote
plans.notes: No prices published; the page offers Request Pricing and a Request Trial button
